name: Витрина «За Энериум»: правка портретов сета III первого прогона jobs/donat-set3.json в режиме EDIT (art/style/style.md: удачную картинку правим, а не рисуем заново). jobs.subject:
1. His face: the smooth pale face-like surface must go completely. Inside the grey hood there is only a smooth, soft, deep darkness, as dark as a night sky — no surface, no mask, no eyes, no nose, no mouth, no features at all.
2. His arms: remove the lone fist in the middle of his chest. The flaming round shield is strapped to his near forearm: his near arm reaches from his shoulder forward to the back of the shield, and his gauntleted hand grips the shield behind its rim, so the shield is clearly held and driven forward. He has exactly two hands: the hand on the shield and the hand that holds the axe low at the left.
